name: Get It Out
rules: A completed scoped claim is not reopened merely because a programme or extension remains open.
Stage labels require their own dated evidence; submission, acceptance, publication and independent review are distinct.
No programme registration or CLI read starts jobs, sends messages, submits papers or authorizes spending.
Public posting and an AI significance score do not establish independent verification, novelty or professional impact.

outputs.title: All-level NANUQ circularity and exact displayed-split support
outputs.scientific_state: Completed computer-assisted hand-proof package at its recorded scope; no new proof review or execution in this organizational update.
outputs.publication_state: Public repository and VibeMathed entry exist; journal submission and independent human expert review are not established.
outputs.candidate_extensions: Separate optional work; must not block release of the existing scoped result indefinitely.
finish_for_submission: Freeze one theorem and source pin with all hypotheses and exclusions.
Check prior work and exact contribution; unresolved novelty must remain explicit.
Produce a self-contained mathematical manuscript and reproducibility appendix.
Record accurate human/AI contributions and actual review; meet selected venue requirements.
Verify references, source/archive rights, prior-publication rules, fees and submission authority.
outputs.next_action: Audit the existing strongest completed packet and choose a manuscript scope before considering new extensions.
outputs.limits: All finite levels within the specified binary semi-directed LSA, outer-labeled planar, galled class; not unrestricted networks, complete biological inference or full all-level Lean verification.
